decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of backpacks, including high-capacity hiking packs (High Sierra), technical ultralights (Osprey), and tactical/daily packs. The QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out as the best value. It has a high 4.7 rating with over 6,000 reviews, indicating significant reliability and customer satisfaction for a very reasonable price of $39.99. While the Osprey is a premium brand, the reviews were mixed on its durability, whereas the QT&QY pack has massive social proof regarding its build quality and versatility for both hiking and daily use.
